note: Open run: the same tool set for every agent and arm, at the same prices (config fixed_tool_prices). Each entry's status is checked at launch and printed in the brief. Wrapped tools run through tools/bt_tool.py, which charges the caller and logs every call; WebSearch/WebFetch are priced and logged by the meter hook.

preform_api.how: bt_tool.py preform_api OP [--body body.json]  (OP: create_scene, import_model, get_scene, delete_scene, open_form, body_count, validate, auto_support, auto_layout, estimate_time, save_form, list_settings; see preform_tool.py for each body)
preform_api.resource: the PreForm adapter (preform_tool.py: a mock in this public copy, or your own authorized PreForm access via BT_PREFORM_ADAPTER): layout, validation, estimates, save .form; printing and device operations are refused; file paths must be in your folders

compute.resource: Brev GPUs through bonetwin/compute/bt_compute.py with a per-run $ cap. An L40S boots in about 90 s; docker and NGC public containers work; pip-installed Warp kernels and PhysicsNeMo imports failed in our test, so prefer NGC containers (recipes in <public>/compute_images.md)

warp_gpu.resource: NVIDIA Warp / warp.fem on the laptop GPU (venv Python)

score_planestress.how: board.py score --design D --fidelity planestress (one shared FIFO slot)

cad_python.resource: venv Python with build123d, manifold3d, trimesh, gmsh, numpy, scipy

openresearch.resource: keyless literature search (alphaXiv, OpenAlex, PubMed); OpenAlex is capped per run (shared daily limit); a 429 is 'unavailable' and not charged

web_search.resource: web search; every query logged and audited

web_fetch.resource: web fetch; every URL logged and audited

measured_data.resource: tonight's raw Breakerspace data and analysis outputs, read-only (imperfect, crosshead-only strain; see CHANGES.md)

board.resource: shared board, collective and planner arms only

not_provided.printing: printers are on an offline network; .form files only
not_provided.onshape_featurescript: no Onshape API keys; Python CAD (build123d, manifold3d) covers it
not_provided.openscad: manifold3d is the same geometry kernel and is provided
not_provided.openresearch_engaging: an external agent group, not reachable from this machine
not_provided.direct_brev_or_wsl: GPU compute only through bt_compute (per-run $ caps)
not_provided.judge_precheck: the judge's pre-check is harness-only: the harness runs it at the deadline to pick the best_of_n submission
